# AdjacencyDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasAdjacencyDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasAdjacencyDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasAdjacencyDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasAdjacencyDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Area-proportional rooms and their adjacencies (space planning)

## Overview

@brief Architectural space-planning adjacency diagram Renders rooms as area-proportional circles colored by functional type, adjacency requirements as solid/dashed/dotted lines between rooms, and functional zones as dashed bounding regions (floors, clusters). Layout is fully manual — the caller positions each room by setting its x/y coordinates. This matches the architectural workflow where a designer iterates on spatial proximity rather than auto-placement. Features: - Room size proportional to floor area (radius = √area × scale) - Five built-in functional type colors + custom override - Three link types: direct (solid), secondary (dashed), service (dotted) - Directed links with arrowheads - Zone bounding boxes with translucent fill and dashed border - Zone and floor labels - Hover and click callbacks for rooms and links - Tooltip showing room name, area, and floor - Pan support via drag (when enablePan = true)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasAdjacencyDiagram> CreateAdjacencyDiagram( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasAdjacencyDiagram(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onRoomClick` | `std::function<void(int, const AdjacencyRoom&)> onRoomClick` | / Fired when a room circle is clicked |
| `onRoomHover` | `std::function<void(int, const AdjacencyRoom&)> onRoomHover` | / Fired when mouse enters a room circle |
| `onLinkClick` | `std::function<void(int, const AdjacencyLink&)> onLinkClick` | / Fired when an adjacency link is clicked |
| `onMatrixCellClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string& rowRoomId, const std::string& colRoomId, const AdjacencyLink* link)> onMatrixCellClick` | / Fired when a matrix cell is clicked, populated or not. The bubble / view has no equivalent — there is nothing to click where two rooms / are unlinked. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

## Option types in this header

### enum `AdjacencyLinkType`

/ Type of physical adjacency between two rooms

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Direct` | /&lt; Solid line — rooms must be directly adjacent / share a wall |
| `Secondary` | /&lt; Dashed line — rooms should be nearby / indirect access |
| `ServiceOnly` | /&lt; Dotted line — service/back-of-house connection only |

### enum `AdjacencyPriority`

/ This is a different axis from AdjacencyLinkType, which says what KIND of / connection it is (a shared wall, an indirect route, a service run). A / service link can itself be mandatory or merely preferred, so the two / overlap on Must/Direct and Should/Secondary but do not coincide. / Priority is what a matrix view plots; the bubble view ignores it.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Must` | /&lt; Red — these spaces must be adjacent |
| `Should` | /&lt; Blue — these spaces should be adjacent / preferred |
| `Maybe` | /&lt; Green — desirable if the plan allows |

### enum `AdjacencyView`

/ Which view the element draws

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Bubble` | /&lt; Area-proportional room circles joined by typed links |
| `Matrix` | /&lt; The same data as a half matrix of spaces against themselves |

### enum `AdjacencyMatrixStyle`

/ How the half matrix is drawn

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Staircase` | /&lt; Axis-aligned grid, upper-right triangle populated |
| `Rotated45` | /&lt; Classic architectural triangle: horizontal labels on |

### enum `RoomFunctionType`

/ Which functional category a room belongs to

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Public` | /&lt; Public-facing spaces (lobbies, reception, meeting rooms) |
| `Private` | /&lt; Private / staff spaces (offices, workrooms) |
| `Service` | /&lt; Service / back-of-house (kitchens, storage, loading) |
| `Support` | /&lt; Support / utility (toilets, plant rooms, corridors) |
| `Circulation` | /&lt; Circulation (halls, stairs, elevators) |
| `Custom` | /&lt; User-defined color via room.color |
